caption: The drawing depicts a decorative architectural element at the intersection of two arching stone structures that form a V-shape in the composition. The stone arches are rendered in shades of reddish-brown with detailed texturing and visible fissures to indicate age and material. In the center, where the arches meet, there is an ornamental design in blue-green and gold tones. This design consists of a stylized three-petaled element with gold outlining and blue-green shading, surmounted by an oval or bulb-shaped structure patterned with small gold dots on a blue-green field and topped by a small sphere. Below this central motif is a round blue-green element linked by a gold scrolling framework. The background is pale, with a light beige wash that leaves most of the space around the central design and arches unadorned. The artist's signature is visible near the bottom right of the image.
title: Ceiling Decoration
